title: A window into HTML and a teapot
expected: The cards and teapot show depth and parallax. The portal border and glass heading stay at the page surface.

title: Shared depth: HTML in front and behind
expected: Occlusion follows geometric depth. The near card is at 230px and the blue card is at 570px.

title: Hover circles with X, Y, and Z spins
expected: X turns end over end, Y turns side to side, and Z turns in its own plane. Each hover region stays still.

title: Labels and rulers attached to a model
expected: The label stays above the transformed model bounds. The width and depth bars follow the model geometry, including entity scale changes.

title: Container axes compared with anchor axes
expected: The container label stays parallel to the containing volume. The anchor-context label turns and scales with its card.

title: Origins, depth edges, and Z alignment
expected: The dot matches the card’s authored 25% / 75% origin. Start, center, and end place the tiles at different depths between the same two insets.
needs: portal depth models anchors area context origin alignment orbit

title: Stage fitting, automatic bounds, and resizing
expected: Automatic fitting scales the whole scene uniformly. Model depth contributes to measured stage bounds.

title: A spinning nested stage that expands on hover
expected: The nested content rotates as one stage and remains in the outer depth scene. The satellites expand while the dashed hover region stays still.

title: Native HTML controls at different depths
expected: Native controls keep their normal DOM behavior. The far card repaints, and restoring the portal restores the mixed scene.

title: Animated USDZ models with HTML attachments
expected: All three native assets animate and occlude HTML normally. Labels use each model’s root bounds rather than individual animated bones or nodes.

title: Clipping at the glass plane
expected: Only the portion behind the glass is rendered. The card’s shadow and model geometry follow the same boundary.

title: Portal airshow: a flight through HTML
expected: The biplane passes in front of the central HTML sign, then behind it on the return leg. The teapot and chameleon share the scene and carry HTML labels.
